newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bonn welcomes OECD call for multilateral air accord.
newsitem.headline: Bonn welcomes OECD call for multilateral air accord.

text.p: An OECD call to drop bilateral air accords in favour of multilateral agreements has been welcomed by German transport minister Matthias Wissmann.
In a newly-published analysis of the international air travel market, the OECD called for existing bilateral deals to be replaced by a multilateral, liberalised air regime, a ministry statement said.
Important elements of this were harmonisation of competition regulations and of national subsidies and tax regulations, it added.

Wissmann said in the statement: "The worldwide trend towards liberalisation and globalisation of air travel demands new solutions beyond bilateral deals. The OECD study provides important impulses for this."
Germany was playing a pioneer role in air liberalisation and saw its new accord with the U.S. as the first step towards an open, market-orientated deal between Europe and America, he added.
